::: {.section-block}
## Teaching philosophy {.section-title}

I believe that students learn by making mistakes. A good teacher provokes students to apply their previous knowledge to new problems, so they can fail safely, reflect, and then learn from the experience.

::: {.callout-card}
### Resources that inform my practice

- [*What the Best College Teachers Do* — Ken Bain](https://www.hup.harvard.edu/catalog.php?isbn=9780674013254)
- [Prof. David Carless on feedback](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pOk6odcV_vI&t=561s)
:::
:::
